title: (agent) Resolve conflict
description: A background Claude session on your node brings the branch up to date with its base in a worktree of its own, resolves the conflicts keeping both sides' intent, runs the tests it can find and pushes to the pull request's branch; it stops and asks when a conflict needs a decision or the tests fail. Merge (the default) pushes plainly; rebase rewrites the pull request's history and force-pushes with lease.

unavailableWhen.reason: Can't tell whether this PR comes from a fork
PR from a fork: can't push to its branch

form.label: Strategy
form.help: Merge adds a merge commit and pushes plainly. Rebase rewrites the pull request's history and force-pushes it with lease (git push --force-with-lease), to the pull request's branch only.
